name: codeboarding-deterministic-multi-candidate-dc5d
instr:
The diagram analysis library cannot reconcile ordered semantic candidates into a deterministic, attributable result across components and directed relations. Add reconciliation without disrupting legacy analyses, preserving decisions and unresolved conflicts through incremental analysis, persistence, and every documentation format.

Reconciliation is deterministic; insertion order breaks equal choices. Equivalent evidence retains every distinct producer, attempt, and baseline origin. Every LLMBaseModel semantic value provides `reconciliation_key(self)` using its existing representation. Compatible component evidence combines names, descriptions, and key entities without changing deterministic membership or locked names. Relation evidence combines each directed pair with deduplicated edges.

Conflicts stay isolated to their semantic key, preserve every rejected origin without inventing a winner, and cannot erase or reorder independent accepted decisions. Persistence round-trips decisions, ordered origins, conflicts, and relation evidence losslessly. Malformed persisted endpoint keys raise a specific reconstruction error.

Incremental context exposes unresolved conflicts and attributable baseline decisions with each affected group and contributing origin.
